faq.question: What are your working hours?
faq.answer: I operate on a flexible schedule to accommodate clients across different time zones. I am available 24/7 for communication and can adjust my working hours to align with your project needs.

faq.question: How do you handle payments?
faq.answer: For most projects, I require a 50% upfront payment to begin work, with the remaining 50% due upon completion. I accept payments through various platforms, including bank transfers and online payment gateways, for your convenience.

faq.question: What is your revision process?
faq.answer: I believe in collaborative success. Each project typically includes two rounds of revisions to ensure the final product meets your expectations. Additional revisions can be accommodated as needed, which may affect the project timeline and cost.

faq.question: Can you handle urgent projects?
faq.answer: Yes, I can often accommodate rush projects depending on my current workload. Urgent projects may be subject to an additional fee. Please contact me with your requirements, and I'll let you know my availability.
